title: Explainable AI for Solar PV Power Forecasting: From Model Selection to Trustworthy, Reproducible Deployment
abstract: arXiv:2611.25894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Machine learning (ML) is now a standard tool for forecasting the output of solar photovoltaic (PV) plants, yet published accuracy figures are often hard to compare and harder to trust. Many studies validate with random splits, report no reference forecast, and present feature attributions without saying what they can and cannot show. This paper reviews the main families of ML methods for PV power forecasting and resource assessment, from tree ensembles to deep and foundation models, and sets out a reproducible workflow that combines automated model search with explainable AI. The workflow is then tested on an openly available dataset: a 16.32 kWp plant in Porto, Portugal, forecast one day ahead from a 4 km numerical weather prediction grid. Over a full test year, the best models reach a normalised root mean square error (nRMSE) of 11.6% of installed capacity, about half the error of smart persistence. translated_title: 用于太阳能光伏功率预测的可解释人工智能：从模型选择到可信、可复现的部署
translated_abstract: 机器学习（ML）现已成为预测太阳能光伏电站输出功率的标准工具，但已发表的精度数据往往难以比较，更难以令人信服。许多研究采用随机划分进行验证、不报告基准预测，并且在给出特征归因时不说明其能揭示和不能揭示的内容。本文综述了用于光伏功率预测与资源评估的主要机器学习方法家族，从树集成模型到深度模型和基础模型，并提出了一种将自动化模型搜索与可解释人工智能相结合的可复现工作流程。随后，该工作流程在一个公开可用的数据集上进行了测试：位于葡萄牙波尔图的一个16.32 kWp光伏电站，基于4 km数值天气预报网格进行提前一天的功率预测。在整个测试年度中，最佳模型达到了占装机容量11.6%的归一化均方根误差（nRMSE），约为智能持续性基准误差的一半。输入特征的选择改变了……
tldr: 本文提出了一种将自动化模型搜索与可解释人工智能相结合的可复现光伏功率预测工作流程，并在葡萄牙波尔图一个16.32 kWp电站上验证，最佳模型达到11.6%的nRMSE，误差约为智能持续性基准的一半。
